name: Rating
description:
A rating chosen from a row of icons, or shown as one. It is a radio group: the question is
"which one of these?", each choice has a name ("3 of 5 stars"), and no choice is a real state
that a slider, which always has a value, cannot say. The group is one tab stop, on the chosen
icon (or the first). The arrow keys move and choose as native radios do: forward (Right, or
Left in a right-to-left language, and Down) raises the rating, back lowers it. Home and End go
to the ends, Space chooses the focused one, and with `clearable` Delete and Backspace clear it.

`step={0.5}` splits every icon into two choices. Their pointer targets are half an icon wide, so
use `size="lg"` for touch. The fill starts at the reading start, so it mirrors in right-to-left
languages. Moving the pointer over the icons previews the rating by changing colour only; the
layout never moves.

With `readOnly` it is an image named with its value ("Rating: 4.3 of 5 stars") that fills to the
exact value, for averages. Bind it to a form with `field.RatingField`.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, max, step, clearable, readOnly, disabled, size, icon, name, invalid, required, valueText, "aria-label": ariaLabel, "aria-labelledby": labelledBy, "aria-describedby": describedBy, onBlur, id, locale: localeProp, className, }: RatingProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of elements that describe the rating, such as a hint. A Field adds its own message.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The group's name when no Field or `aria-labelledby` names it. Default "Rating". For a read-only display, the name that precedes the value.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the group by another element, such as a heading. Takes the place of `aria-label`.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Choosing the current rating again, or pressing Delete or Backspace, clears it. Default false.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting rating when uncontrolled. Default `null`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon, drawn outlined when empty and filled when chosen. Pass it without a size. Default a star.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Show the invalid state (set by RatingField when its error shows).

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: max
props.description: How many icons there are, and so the highest rating. Default 5.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a native form submission (a hidden input carries the rating, empty for none).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the group, for form libraries' touched state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen rating, or `null` when it is cleared.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the rating without a way to change it. It is then a single image with the value as its name, not a group of choices, so it can sit in a list or card.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size. Default `md`.

props.name: step
props.description: `1` chooses whole icons; `0.5` also chooses half of one. A read-only display ignores it and fills to the exact value. Default 1.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating, from 0 to `max`; `null` is no rating. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Words for a rating, such as "3 hearts out of 5". Default "3.5 of 5 stars".
